description: a tall cylinder of radius 1 on z, made of two coaxial cylinders stacked (z 0..2 and z 2..4) that a fuse leaves as two lateral faces on one cylinder, the circle at z = 2 smooth between them; a box [0.6, 1.8] x [-0.2, 0.2] x [0, 2] fused on its side. The concave edge where the box's face y = 0.2 meets the cylinder ends at z = 2, on the circle, at a vertex whose face across is those flush cylinder pieces. Flush pieces are a fan on one plane only (ADR-0082 §4): on one cylinder the end is VertexBlend, named, where Open CASCADE builds it (plans/flush-fan-end step 5)
